data.assumption: I interpreted “an average order in India” as every non-test order from an India showroom, including orders with zero non-test payment attempts, averaged by its count of non-test payment attempts.
data.sql:
SELECT AVG(per_order.attempt_count) AS avg_payment_attempts_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(pa.attempt_id) AS attempt_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
  JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
  LEFT JOIN payment_attempts pa
    ON pa.order_id = o.order_id
   AND pa.is_test = false
  WHERE o.is_test = false
    AND c.name = 'India'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) per_order
